title: A visit to the library
instructions: Bir öğrenci kütüphanede kitap alıyor. Kaç kitap ve ne zaman getirmesi gerektiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hello. Can I take these two books, please?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Sure. Do you have your library card?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Thank you. Please bring them back in three weeks.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Is the library open on Sunday?

script.speaker: b
script.text: No, it's closed on Sundays and Mondays.
